purpose: Teach: 大卒/常駐/還流/短絡/受話器/取り引き/改名/おもに

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 大卒採用と中途採用のバランスを見ましょう
lines.en: Let's review the balance between new graduate hires and mid-career recruits.
lines.style: Brisk, businesslike. Clean attack on the opening. Professional cadence, no hesitation. Straightforward instruction delivered with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規事業所には警備員を常駐させます
lines.en: Yes. We'll have security staff permanently stationed at the new office.
lines.style: Cooperative, responsive. Light nod in the voice. Acknowledges and confirms with steady clarity. Professional, supporting her lead.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外子会社からの還流配当を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's verify the repatriated dividends from our overseas subsidiaries.
lines.style: Clear, methodical direction. Steady pace. No inflection for drama — just moving through the agenda item with competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の苦情を短絡的にとらえないようにします
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure not to oversimplify customer complaints.
lines.style: Measured, attentive. Taking the note seriously. Slight emphasis on the commitment — not defensive, just confirming understanding.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィスの受話器を全て更新しましょう
lines.en: Let's update all the office handsets.
lines.style: Direct, decisive. Brief but not curt. The voice of someone moving through a checklist with purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取り引き先のリストを準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the list of new partner companies.
lines.style: Professional update delivered smoothly. Quiet satisfaction in having prepared. Efficient, ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店舗の改名案を会議で議論しましょう
lines.en: Let's discuss the store rebrand proposal at the meeting.
lines.style: Clear directive with forward momentum. Professional, inclusive tone — 'let's' signals collaboration. No rush, but purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当部署はおもに広報を担当しております
lines.en: Yes. Our department primarily handles public relations.
lines.style: Closing statement, slightly formal. Steady, informative. The tone of someone wrapping up a point with clarity and respect.
